title: antilla bahorucensis
intro: Antilla bahorucensis, commonly known as the Bahoruc tree, is a plant species native to the tropical rainforests of Central and South America. It is a tree that belongs to the Apocynaceae family and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Antilla bahorucensis include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
